mapper.select: SELECT security_type ,security_type_name FROM dict_security_type WHERE category_type = 'fund' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT security_type ,security_type_name FROM dict_security_type WHERE category_type = 'fund' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT fi.fund_code ,fi.fund_name ,fi.fund_short_name ,fi.market_code ,fi.security_type ,dst.security_type_name FROM rrs_fundinfo fi INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = fi.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'fund' AND dst.is_deleted = 0
fi.is_deleted = 0 AND fi.security_status != 'D' AND (fi.source_system IS NULL OR fi.source_system != 'temporary')
AND (fi.fund_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fundKeyword}, '%') OR fi.fund_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fundKeyword}, '%') OR fi.fund_short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fundKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY fi.updt_time DESC ,fi.fund_code LIMIT 50

SELECT fi.fund_code ,fi.fund_name ,fi.fund_short_name ,fi.market_code ,fi.security_type ,dst.security_type_name FROM rrs_fundinfo fi INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = fi.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'fund' AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fi.fund_code = #{fundCode} AND fi.is_deleted = 0 AND fi.security_status != 'D' AND (fi.source_system IS NULL OR fi.source_system != 'temporary')

SELECT t.* ,td.security_type_name AS temp_security_type_name ,fd.security_type_name FROM rrs_temp_fund_code t LEFT JOIN dict_security_type td ON td.security_type = t.temp_security_type AND td.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dict_security_type fd ON fd.security_type = t.security_type AND fd.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM rrs_temp_fund_code WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM rrs_temp_fund_code WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM rrs_fundinfo WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rrs_temp_fund_code WHERE temp_fund_code = #{fundCode} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rrs_temp_fund_code WHERE temp_fund_code = #{fundCode} AND status = 'temporary' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rrs_temp_fund_code_evt ( id ,temp_fund_code ,temp_fund_short_name ,temp_security_type ,temp_market_code ,fund_code ,fund_name ,fund_short_name ,market_code ,security_type ,update_time ,status ,is_deleted ,oprt_source ,memo ,crte_time ,updt_time ,opter_id ,opt_time ,oprt_type ) SELECT t.id ,t.temp_fund_code ,t.temp_fund_short_name ,t.temp_security_type ,t.temp_market_code ,t.fund_code ,t.fund_name ,t.fund_short_name ,t.market_code ,t.security_type ,t.update_time ,t.status ,t.is_deleted ,t.oprt_source ,t.memo ,t.crte_time ,t.updt_time ,#{operatorId} ,#{now} ,#{oprtType} FROM rrs_temp_fund_code t WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ip_adjust_log_fund WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ip_pool_status_fund WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND is_deleted = 0) AS ref_count
SELECT * FROM ip_adjust_log_fund WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND is_deleted = 0 AND audit_status IN ('00', '11') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT ps.* ,ps.id AS pool_status_id ,ps.adjust_log_id AS source_adjust_log_id FROM ip_pool_status_fund ps WHERE ps.fund_code = #{fundCode} AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ps.id FOR UPDATE
